official_rule_note: No federal restriction on students working part-time; on-campus jobs limited and competitive.
source: General labor guidance; verify with individual university career office

official_rule_note: International students on a valid student pass may work up to 20 hours/week during semester breaks only, subject to Immigration Department approval; rules can vary by institution.
source: https://www.educationmalaysia.gov.my (verify current rules before relying on this)

official_rule_note: Standard student visas generally do not permit part-time employment; some universities offer paid on-campus internship programs only.
source: General guidance; verify current UAE immigration rules before relying on this
